policy.name: fixed_parallel_refine
policy.rationale: Open all available directions and refine uniformly to the shared cap.

task_input.description: Parse a URL query string into an object mapping each key to a list of decoded values in occurrence order. Decode plus as a space and percent escapes; preserve blank values and repeated keys. An optional leading ? is allowed.

baseline_artifact:
def query_values(query):
    return dict(part.split("=") for part in query.split("&"))
